news.q: Jayson Tatum led the Celtics past the Wizards 131-116 on Tuesday, Nov. 24, snapping a four-game skid. How many points did he score?
news.fact: He scored 28 of them in the first half.

news.q: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade marches on Nov. 26 with a record-breaking lineup. How many inflatable elements will it feature?
news.fact: The 2.5-mile route runs from the Upper West Side to Herald Square.

easy.q: Leonardo da Vinci began painting the Mona Lisa in 1503. In what numbered century is that?
easy.fact: He kept working on it for years and never delivered it to the patron.

easy.q: How many kids do Bob and Helen Parr have in Pixar's The Incredibles?
How many U.S. states are not part of the contiguous 48?
easy.fact: Alaska and Hawaii both joined the Union in 1959.

easy.q: LeBron James won NBA titles with the Heat, Cavaliers and Lakers. How many did he win in all from 2012 through 2020?
easy.fact: He was named Finals MVP every time.

easy.q: How many hours long is France's famous Le Mans endurance car race?
easy.fact: The first one was run in 1923.

medium.q: In what year did President Eisenhower sign the law that created the Interstate Highway System?
medium.fact: Eisenhower was inspired by Germany's autobahns.

medium.q: How many seasons did The Vampire Diaries run on The CW?
medium.fact: It ran from 2009 to 2017 and spun off The Originals.

medium.q: To the nearest foot, how tall is California's General Sherman, the world's largest tree by volume?
medium.fact: Its trunk is about 36 feet across at the base.

medium.q: How many feet long is a standard NHL rink?
How many John Wick movies did Keanu Reeves make, through 2023's John Wick: Chapter 4?

hard.q: The Spanish Armada sailed against England in 1588 with about how many ships, to the nearest 10?
hard.fact: Storms wrecked many of its ships on the way home.

hard.q: How many episodes of HBO's The Wire aired over its five seasons?
hard.fact: Each season focused on a different part of Baltimore.

hard.q: To the nearest hundred feet, how high above sea level is the top of Yosemite's Half Dome?
hard.fact: Its summit is about 4,800 feet above the valley floor.

hard.q: Cy Young holds the MLB record for career pitching wins. How many did he win?
hard.fact: He also holds the record for career losses, with 316.
